matrix_Bernstein.source: Joel A. Tropp, User-Friendly Tail Bounds for Sums of Random Matrices

certificate.target: round(continuous Gaussian of width q*alpha), then modulo q if requested
certificate.randomness_assumption: independent uniform bytes; errors of faulty sources propagate

matrix_R_finite_scalar_certificate.algorithm: finite uniform-box rejection Gaussian, independent wide profile
matrix_R_finite_scalar_certificate.rounding_assumption: correctly-rounded directed rational conversion, pi, arithmetic and exp in MPFR/MPFI; exponents explicitly clipped before underflow
matrix_R_finite_scalar_certificate.randomness: independent uniform bytes; fixed test seeds are not security evidence

matrix_R_finite_invertibility_certificat.scalar_distribution_scope: finite output conditioned on scalar success

matrix_R_finite_sampler_accounting.symmetry_reason: center-zero support is symmetric and integer_weight depends on x^2; each scalar uses an independent fixed-length tape

transformation_operator_bound.conditioning_basis: finite max-atom/column-span certificate proves probability above 1/2; ABB10 Definition 7 states fewer than two expected ideal attempts

root_trapdoor_recovery.model: conditional AP09 alternative-preimage reduction to homogeneous Euclidean SIS
root_trapdoor_recovery.actual_matrix_distribution: uniform A1 conditioned on full row rank
root_trapdoor_recovery.public_G_reconstruction: canonical AP09 G is determined by public A1
root_trapdoor_recovery.planted_preimage_distribution: independent two-bit differences: P(-1)=1/4, P(0)=1/2, P(1)=1/4
root_trapdoor_recovery.attack_goal: recover enough bounded alternative R columns to reconstruct an AP09 root trapdoor
root_trapdoor_recovery.estimated_subgoal: one distinct bounded preimage column induces one nonzero SIS vector
reduction_conditions: the recovered bounded preimage differs from the planted column
both planted and recovered columns have Euclidean norm at most sqrt(random_rows)

ciphertext_lwe.attack_goal: recover fresh encryption vector from public preamble, then decode message

runtime_blockers: complete basis remains hundreds of terabytes
current BasisDel/RandBasis/SamplePre consumers materialize complete bases
raw 32-byte ciphertext remains tens of gigabytes
literal finite SampleR fixed tapes and m^2 scalar draws are prohibitive
complete finite SampleR-to-ABB proof/reduction mapping is not reviewed
root trapdoor-recovery comparison remains unresolved
